q1_issues.issue: The copular state "was ashamed" is reified without the flat copular atom (Past (Member sk_man_1 ashamed)) — the instruction set allows either the flat form alone or reified-plus-flat, never reified alone, so "was the man ashamed?" cannot bind.

q2_gaps: a predicate-adjective psych state with a prepositional complement ("ashamed OF X"): nothing licenses reifying the state for that complement (the reification triggers are resultatives, connective endpoints, time-modified copulars), and Stimulus is defined for an entity or for the perceived event of a perception report, not for an emotive of-complement
gerundive passive complement "being born poor" — no rule fixes whether such a non-finite complement is asserted at top level, tensed, or marked Ongoing
notes: "born" is lemmatized to `bear` (inflectional, per the lemmatization rule) and the man is its Patient, which is the passive's active-role mapping; the depictive "poor" is emitted flat with no Result link, as the depictive rule requires, though untensed under a past host — the instruction set's own resultative example does the same, so this is not scored as a defect.
